files.description: Rules for any agent working on Djinn, and the interface rules (borders, lists that stay put, text fields).
The project's shape (the lamp and the smoke), its technical directions, how tests are written, how we work, dependencies and licenses.
What Djinn is, and the limits no option turns off.
Known traps of the code, by area: Go tests and CI, interface, end-to-end specs, Windows and macOS, processes, permissions, store, window, releases.
The command line convention: commands come from the protos, with no code per command.
Providers and workers: how a worker ends, what it may do, the order of decision of its rights, recorded streams for tests.
How the window, the browser and the command line reach the server, with the measures behind the choice.
Team settings in .agents/: checks, integration, pushing, branch names; who wins between files.
